punch_wood.name: Punch Wood
punch_wood.description: Gather wood logs by punching tree trunks.

crafting_table.name: Make Crafting Table
crafting_table.description: Craft a 3x3 crafting table using four wooden planks.

wooden_pickaxe.name: Craft Wooden Pickaxe
wooden_pickaxe.description: Craft a wooden pickaxe to begin mining stone.

stone_age.name: Mine Cobblestone
stone_age.description: Mine cobblestone with a wooden pickaxe.

stone_tools_and_furnace.name: Craft Stone Tools & Furnace
stone_tools_and_furnace.description: Upgrade to stone equipment and build a furnace for smelting.

iron_age.name: Mine & Smelt Iron
iron_age.description: Mine raw iron from caves or mountains and smelt it in a furnace.

iron_gear_and_shield.name: Craft Iron Armor, Pickaxe & Shield
iron_gear_and_shield.description: Equip full iron armor, craft an iron pickaxe, shield, and water bucket.

diamonds.name: Mine Diamonds
diamonds.description: Mine deep underground (Y=-58) with an iron pickaxe to uncover diamonds.

diamond_pickaxe.name: Craft Diamond Pickaxe
diamond_pickaxe.description: Craft a diamond pickaxe, the only tool capable of harvesting obsidian.

obsidian_and_nether_portal.name: Harvest Obsidian & Light Nether Portal
obsidian_and_nether_portal.description: Mine 10-14 obsidian blocks and build a 4x5 vertical portal frame, then ignite with flint and steel.

enchanting_setup.name: Build Enchanting Table & Bookshelves
enchanting_setup.description: Craft an enchanting table and surround it with 15 bookshelves for level 30 enchantments.

nether_fortress.name: Explore Nether Fortress & Gather Blaze Rods
nether_fortress.description: Navigate the Nether to find a Fortress, defeat Blazes for rods, and collect nether wart.

eyes_of_ender.name: Brewing & Craft Eyes of Ender
eyes_of_ender.description: Craft blaze powder and combine with ender pearls to produce Eyes of Ender.

stronghold.name: Locate & Activate Stronghold End Portal
stronghold.description: Throw Eyes of Ender to track down the Stronghold portal room and fill empty frame sockets.

ender_dragon.name: Defeat the Ender Dragon
ender_dragon.description: Destroy the End Crystals on obsidian towers, slay the Ender Dragon, and unlock the End Gateway.

end_cities_and_elytra.name: Loot End Cities & Obtain Elytra
end_cities_and_elytra.description: Explore outer End islands, loot End Cities, defeat Shulkers for boxes, and claim the Elytra from an End Ship.
